Michalovce Jewish Cemetery in Hradok

Jewish Cemetery · Michalovce, Slovakia

Not demolished. This is Michalovce's Jewish cemetery at Hrádek, marked on Austro-Hungarian maps from 1866 and the 1880s, most likely emerging in the mid-19th century. According to the town's own Yizkor memorial book, 'The first Jewish cemetery was in Straniany, opposite the Red Wood. Later Count Sztaray gave a Hrádek hill for that purpose.' The record book of the local Chevra Kadisha, listing individuals buried at both this cemetery and the earlier one at Straniany, documented elsewhere in this collection, has survived to this day in Košice.
